load_compression_model: load a pretrained audio compression model from a local file, URL, or HuggingFace repo checkpoint
load_lm_model: load a pretrained language model for audio generation from a checkpoint file or HuggingFace repo
load_lm_model_magnet: load a MAGNeT music generation model from a checkpoint with a specified compression model frame rate
load_diffusion_models: load multi-band diffusion models and processors from a checkpoint file or HuggingFace repo
load_audioseal_models: load AudioSeal watermark generator and detector models from a checkpoint file or HuggingFace repo
